performance.name: The End of the Summer
performance.description: 112 BPM | E minor | 168 bars | 6:00 including decay. Dark wave: a cold industrial pulse interrupted by warm strings and brass. 0:00 Clouds; 0:34 Machinery; 1:43 First sunlight; 2:00 Clouds return; 3:09 Open sky; 3:43 Warmth within the machine; 4:51 Unwinding; 5:26 A little warmth survives. Finite Pad Looper arrangement, Repeat off. Final four bars reserved for tails.

patchDefinitions.name: Analog Drumkit
patchDefinitions.description: Five velocity-sensitive analog synthesis voices selected by MIDI notnum through Switch. MIDI notenum 35: Bass drum (pitch-swept sine + click); 36: Bass drum distorted (saturated sine + click); 46: Hi-hat open (700 ms); 42: Hi-hat closed (85 ms); 38: Snare (two sine resonances + filtered noise). Hats use six inharmonic square oscillators plus noise. One-shot decays survive short MIDI note-offs. Silent default; stereo output; no samples. GM bass-drum slot 36 is used for the distorted variation.

hihat_open_highpass::asig.expression: metal1 + metal2 + metal3 + metal4 + metal5 + metal6 + air

hihat_closed_highpass::asig.expression: metal1 + metal2 + metal3 + metal4 + metal5 + metal6 + air

patchDefinitions.name: EBM DW — Sequencer Bass
patchDefinitions.description: Lean dry pulse/saw bass for short external sixteenth-note sequences. Velocity changes filter brightness; no built-in sequencer. Suggested MIDI 28–60. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patchDefinitions.name: EBM DW — Industrial Stab
patchDefinitions.description: Pitched metallic FM strike with a separate short noise transient, distortion and compact room ambience. Suggested MIDI 36–84. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patchDefinitions.name: EBM DW — Dark PWM Pad
patchDefinitions.description: Shadowy triangle/pulse pad with slow PWM and filter movement, chorus and restrained reverb. Suggested MIDI 43–79. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patchDefinitions.name: EBM DW — Dark Saw Lead
patchDefinitions.description: Cold expressive saw lead with modest detune, subtle vibrato, animated stereo chorus and quiet filtered echoes. Suggested MIDI 48–84. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patchDefinitions.name: EBM DW — String Ensemble
patchDefinitions.description: Melancholic three-layer string ensemble with independent stereo chorus movement and dark reverb. Suggested MIDI 43–84. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patchDefinitions.name: EBM DW — Analog Brass
patchDefinitions.description: Dramatic saw brass with a separate opening filter envelope and a quiet room tail. Suggested MIDI 43–79. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patchDefinitions.name: EBM DW — Glass Bell
patchDefinitions.description: Cold glass bell with an inharmonic two-operator FM strike, decaying brightness and dark echoes/reverb. Suggested MIDI 48–88. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patchDefinitions.name: EBM DW — Noise Metal FX
patchDefinitions.description: Sustained mechanical noise/FM texture with slow spectral sweeps and dark ambience. Note pitch controls the metal layer. Suggested MIDI 36–79. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.
